items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: One night we played a big party given for Ali Kahn, the son of the Aga Kahn.

ctx.x: Sometimes when I would be taking my afternoon siesta I would hear some Indian music on someone's gramaphone and it was great music. They had their type of jazz which included a great soloist on instruments of which I did not know the names of and favorite singers. I suppose that (I had) been an arranger I would have taken more interest in the Indian music. But I did listen to those sounds coming from someone's appartment and get my kicks. I'm sorry that I did not buy even an instrumental or vocal record. But I…

One night we played a big party given for Ali Kahn, the son of the Aga Kahn. This party was on a boat and was catered by the Taj Mahal hotel. I think that it was the birthday of Ali but anyway the diplomats, Maharajahs, Maharanies and Bombay high society were there. The boat

sailed out into the bay and after dinner Ali Kahn wanted to take his clothes off and dive in the bay from the highest deck and swim around the boat. It was said that that was high delight whenever he went out on a boating party. But he was restrained that night because it was rumoured that there were sharks in the bay and they could have been attracted by the lights of the boat although we did not see any.
